name: Santa Helena del Opón (Colombia)
description: Green field with a large blue triangle from the hoist bearing a white triangle with a red stripe and yellow stars with the digits of 1975.
history: Municipal flag of Santa Helena del Opón, a municipality in the department of Santander, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: large triangle from the hoist reaching the fly
horizontal stripe on the inner triangle
four stars bearing the digits 1, 9, 7 and 5, with a dotted arc
